title: Navigation Accessibility and Usability
learning_outcomes: Explain the purpose of navigation accessibility and usability and when it is appropriate.
Apply choosing semantic navigation elements using the documented Bootstrap 5.3 pattern.
Check clear labels and current-page states and identify one likely failure mode.

content.intro: In this lesson, you will study navigation accessibility and usability and connect it to a small implementation or review task. The included subtopics preserve the attached Bootstrap curriculum outline.
content.why_it_matters: Navigation Accessibility and Usability helps people understand where they are and how to reveal related content. Use the right semantic element, visible active/current state, and keyboard/touch checks at multiple widths.

common_mistakes.problem: Treating navigation accessibility and usability as a visual-only change.
common_mistakes.why: A class or style does not automatically add semantic meaning, application logic, or secure server behavior.
common_mistakes.fix: Use the appropriate HTML semantics and verify the actual interaction.

common_mistakes.problem: Checking only the default viewport or happy path.
common_mistakes.why: Responsive changes and interaction states can reveal issues that are not visible in a single screenshot.
common_mistakes.fix: Repeat the task at a narrow and a wide viewport and include keyboard/error state checks where relevant.
